questions.q: Why do only Import-mode semantic models need a data refresh?
options: Import mode copies source data into the model, so that copy goes stale and needs re-importing; DirectQuery/live connection modes query the source live and never copy data in
All storage modes need a data refresh equally
DirectQuery models need refresh but Import models don't
Only Push mode semantic models ever need a refresh
questions.explain: DirectQuery, Direct Lake, and live connection modes query the source directly on every interaction, so there's no stale copy to catch up — refresh only matters for the copied data in Import mode.

questions.q: How many scheduled refreshes per day does a semantic model on shared capacity (Power BI Pro) get, compared to Premium/Fabric capacity?
options: Up to 8 on shared capacity, up to 48 on Premium/PPU/Fabric capacity
Unlimited on both
Up to 48 on shared capacity, up to 8 on Premium capacity
Exactly 1 per day regardless of capacity
questions.explain: Shared capacity is capped at 8 scheduled refreshes daily; Premium Per User, Premium, or Fabric capacity raises that to 48.

questions.q: Does clicking 'Refresh now' count against the scheduled-refresh daily quota?
options: No — it's separate from the scheduled quota, though it still consumes real capacity resources
Yes, it counts as one of the 8 or 48 scheduled refreshes
It counts double against the quota
Refresh now is only available on Premium capacity
questions.explain: Manual on-demand refreshes via 'Refresh now' don't count toward the 8-per-day (or 48-per-day) scheduled limit, but they aren't free — they still use capacity resources.

questions.q: What is the difference between a data refresh and a tile refresh?
options: Data refresh re-imports source data into the semantic model; tile refresh only updates a dashboard tile's cached visual, roughly hourly, independent of the underlying data
They are the exact same operation under two different names
Tile refresh re-imports data; data refresh only updates dashboard visuals
Data refresh only applies to dashboards, never reports
questions.explain: Data refresh is about the semantic model's imported data. Tile refresh is a smaller, separate mechanism that keeps dashboard tiles visually current on roughly an hourly cadence.

questions.q: Why does a service refresh fail after a column is renamed at the data source without republishing from Desktop?
options: Data refresh only re-imports rows — it doesn't pick up structural changes, which require a schema refresh done in Desktop and republished
Renaming a column never causes any refresh issue
The service automatically detects and fixes renamed columns
Only removing a column causes a failure — renaming is always safe
questions.explain: The Power BI service performs data refresh only, not schema refresh. A structural change (rename, add, remove) has to be picked up in Desktop and republished before the service's refresh will succeed again.
